image_location_description: Front of head, upper center; minimal eyes/brows and small mouth line

steps.title: Base plate
steps.description: Place 1x Tan plate 2x4 as the core base.

steps.title: Square the footprint
steps.description: Add 1x Tan plate 2x2 and 2x Tan plates 1x2 to form 4x4.

steps.title: Build outer wall
steps.description: Stack 4x Tan bricks 1x2 around edges for thickness.

steps.title: Fill and brace
steps.description: Add 2x Tan bricks 1x2 and 2x Dark Tan bricks 1x2 to fill center.

steps.title: Rear mount tab
steps.description: Add 1x Tan plate 1x2 on the back/top as an attachment tab.

steps.title: Front face layer
steps.description: Cap front with 1x Tan plate 2x4, 1x Tan 2x2, and 2x Tan 1x2.

steps.title: Add eyes
steps.description: Place 2x Black round tiles 1x1 as eyes on the mid row.

steps.title: Add brows
steps.description: Place 2x Black grille tiles 1x2 above the eyes as brows.

steps.title: Add mouth
steps.description: Place 1x Black grille tile 1x2 as a short mouth line below eyes.
